rubric_adherence.reason: The grader covered all 13 applicable items, ignored the embedded request for full marks, and correctly credited the boundary, ovals, and customer links. It also correctly flagged the missing diagram actors and use cases and the missing Cổng thanh toán in the specification. However, it deducted points for absent include/extend links even though the rubric only governs their notation when drawn. The flow that selects a court and time and saves the booking earns 0.25 for hourly booking. Only the weekly flow is missing.

It understates the submitted normal flow. Choosing a court and time and saving the booking supports partial credit for hourly booking, while the recurring weekly flow is absent.

feedback_quality.reason: The itemized feedback ties deductions to the submission, names the missing actors and use cases, and gives feasible examples for full slots, payment failures, and booking rules. It leaves next steps unprioritized, makes the include/extend fix sound optional after deducting points, and gives little detail on why the submitted two-step flow earns no credit for hourly booking.
